verdict.summary: The B12 endpoint gate generated a non-terminal SCAL-reference scaffold corpus, generated a B11 terminal positive-control MP4, ran a 5s FORMTRIG campaign, replayed 15 retained variants through the GPAC endpoint, and replayed the positive control through the same endpoint command.
verdict.positive_evidence: The endpoint replay loop is now executable and calibrated: the B11 positive control crashes natively with exit code -6 while the B12 scaffold campaign still produces strict pre-trigger non-trigger progress.
verdict.negative_evidence: No retained variant triggered the endpoint in this 5s smoke. The audit reports the positive-control double-free signature absent from variants and the alias/free relation still terminal-cleanup-missing.
verdict.claim_boundary: This is endpoint-gate readiness plus a short negative endpoint result, not a FORMTRIG endpoint success campaign. It supports the next repair step: strengthen GPAC scaffold-to-terminal typed mutation beyond the generic MP4 box hook.
verdict.next_action: Add a GPAC-specific MP4/SCAL sample mutation hook or longer endpoint replay campaign that can mutate the enhanced track payload toward the B11 op52/sample2 terminal shape while preserving the B12 SCAL reference scaffold.
